# @asyst/atlas

> Atlas Design System — React components and design tokens by Asyst. Version 0.2.0. React + Tailwind CSS v4 components styled with Atlas design tokens (CSS variables).

## Setup

- Install: `npm install github:androsap/atlas-design-system#semver:^0.2.0` (peer deps: react, react-dom, tailwindcss v4). Import name stays `@asyst/atlas`.
- CSS (before Tailwind): `@import "@asyst/atlas/tokens.css";` then `@import "tailwindcss";`
- Let Tailwind scan the components: `@source "../node_modules/@asyst/atlas/dist";`
- Import: `import { Button } from "@asyst/atlas"`
- Dark mode: set `data-theme="dark"` on <html>.
- Icon props take a lucide-react component, e.g. `leadingIcon={Plus}`.

## Components

### Alert
Props:
- color?: "neutral" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" (default "neutral")
- layout?: "stacked" | "inline" (default "stacked") — "stacked" (default): the action sits below the description — room to breathe for a notice living inline in the page.
- icon?: LucideIcon
- title: string
- children?: ReactNode
- actionLabel?: string
- onAction?: () => void
- onDismiss?: () => void
- dismissible?: boolean (default true)
- className?: string
Example: `<Alert title="..." color="info" layout="inline">Label</Alert>`

### Badge
Props:
- color?: "neutral" | "primary" | "secondary" | "info" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" (default "neutral")
- variant?: "fill" | "outline" | "light" (default "fill")
- size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" (default "md")
- leadingIcon?: LucideIcon
- trailingIcon?: LucideIcon
- dot?: boolean (default false) — Renders as a small colored dot instead of a label — a minimal presence/unread indicator, no text.
- children?: ReactNode
- className?: string
Example: `<Badge color="primary" variant="outline">Label</Badge>`

### Breadcrumbs
Props:
- items: BreadcrumbItem[]
- className?: string
- linkComponent?: ElementType (default "a") — Component used to render linked crumbs.
Example: `<Breadcrumbs items={[{ label: "Home", href: "/" }, { label: "Settings" }]} />`

### Button
Props:
- color?: "brand" | "neutral" | "danger" | "warning" | "success" (default "brand")
- variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "tertiary" (default "primary")
- size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" (default "md")
- leadingIcon?: LucideIcon
- trailingIcon?: LucideIcon
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes.
Example: `<Button color="neutral" variant="secondary">Label</Button>`

### Calendar
Props:
- month: Date — Any date within the month to display — only year/month are read.
- today?: Date (default new Date())
- selected?: Date | null (default null)
- rangeStart?: Date | null (default null)
- rangeEnd?: Date | null (default null)
- onSelectDate?: (date: Date) => void
- showPrev?: boolean (default true)
- showNext?: boolean (default true)
- onPrev?: () => void
- onNext?: () => void
- className?: string
Example: `<Calendar month={new Date()} />`

### Checkbox
Props:
- color?: "primary" | "danger" | "neutral" (default "primary")
- size?: "sm" | "md" (default "md")
- label?: string
- helperText?: string
- indeterminate?: boolean (default false) — Visual "some but not all" state — sets the real DOM .indeterminate property (there's no HTML attribute for it) via a ref effect.
- focused?: boolean (default false) — Force the focused visual state, independent of real DOM focus.
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes.
Example: `<Checkbox label="Label" color="danger" size="sm" />`

### Chip
Props:
- color?: "neutral" | "primary" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" (default "neutral")
- variant?: "fill" | "outline" (default "fill")
- size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" (default "md")
- selected?: boolean
- defaultSelected?: boolean (default false)
- onSelectedChange?: (selected: boolean) => void
- leadingIcon?: LucideIcon
- trailingIcon?: LucideIcon
- onRemove?: () => void — Renders a real, independently-clickable remove button in the trailing slot instead of trailingIcon — the classic removable-tag use case.
- focused?: boolean (default false) — Docs-only: force the focus-visible ring without real keyboard focus.
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes.
Example: `<Chip color="primary" variant="outline">Label</Chip>`

### DatePicker
Props:
- value?: Date | null
- defaultValue?: Date | null (default null)
- onChange?: (date: Date) => void
- placeholder?: string (default "Select a date")
- disabled?: boolean (default false)
- className?: string
Example: `<DatePicker />`

### DateRangePicker
Props:
- value?: DateRange
- defaultValue?: DateRange (default EMPTY_RANGE)
- onChange?: (range: DateRange) => void
- disabled?: boolean (default false)
- className?: string
Example: `<DateRangePicker />`

### DropdownMenu
Also accepts: Radix primitive props.
Example: `<DropdownMenu><DropdownMenuTrigger asChild><Button>Open</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger><DropdownMenuContent><DropdownMenuItem>Edit</DropdownMenuItem></DropdownMenuContent></DropdownMenu>`

### DropdownMenuContent
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes, Radix primitive props.
Example: `<DropdownMenuContent>Label</DropdownMenuContent>`

### DropdownMenuItem
Props:
- variant?: "default" | "danger" (default "default")
- active?: boolean (default false) — Visually marks this as the currently active/selected item.
- forceHighlighted?: boolean (default false) — Docs-only: force the hover/highlighted look without real pointer interaction, for a static side-by-side state comparison.
- leadingIcon?: LucideIcon
- trailingIcon?: LucideIcon
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes, Radix primitive props.
Example: `<DropdownMenuItem variant="danger">Label</DropdownMenuItem>`

### DropdownMenuLabel
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes, Radix primitive props.
Example: `<DropdownMenuLabel>Label</DropdownMenuLabel>`

### DropdownMenuSeparator
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes, Radix primitive props.
Example: `<DropdownMenuSeparator />`

### DropdownMenuTrigger
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes, Radix primitive props.
Example: `<DropdownMenuTrigger asChild><Button>Open</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>`

### Input
Props:
- size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" (default "md")
- label?: string
- helperText?: string
- error?: boolean (default false)
- focused?: boolean (default false) — Force the focused visual state, independent of real DOM focus — for compound fields where an adjacent control should visually "own" this input's focus ring.
- leadingIcon?: LucideIcon
- trailingIcon?: LucideIcon
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes.
Example: `<Input label="Label" size="sm" />`

### Progress
Props:
- value: number — 0–100.
- color?: "neutral" | "info" | "danger" (default "neutral")
- layout?: "stacked" | "inline" (default "stacked") — "stacked" (default): label/percentage sit above a full-width bar.
- label?: string
- helperText?: string
- showValue?: boolean (default true)
- className?: string
Example: `<Progress label="Label" value={0} color="info" layout="inline" />`

### RadioButton
Props:
- color?: "primary" | "danger" | "neutral" (default "primary")
- size?: "sm" | "md" (default "md")
- label?: string
- helperText?: string
- focused?: boolean (default false) — Force the focused visual state, independent of real DOM focus.
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes.
Example: `<RadioButton label="Label" color="danger" size="sm" />`

### Spinner
Props:
- color?: "neutral" | "info" | "danger" (default "neutral")
- size?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" (default "md")
- label?: string (default "Loading") — Accessible name — what's actually loading.
- className?: string
Example: `<Spinner label="Label" color="info" size="xs" />`

### Switch
Props:
- color?: "neutral" | "primary" | "status" (default "neutral")
- size?: "sm" | "md" (default "md")
- label?: string
- helperText?: string
- focused?: boolean (default false) — Docs-only: force the focus-visible ring without real keyboard focus.
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes.
Example: `<Switch label="Label" color="primary" size="sm" />`

### Textarea
Props:
- label?: string
- helperText?: string
- error?: boolean (default false)
- focused?: boolean (default false) — Force the focused visual state, independent of real DOM focus.
- trailingIcon?: LucideIcon
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes.
Example: `<Textarea label="Label" />`

### Toaster
Props:
- children: ReactNode
Example: `<Toaster><App /></Toaster>  // then: const toast = useToast(); toast({ title: "Saved", color: "success" })`

### Tooltip
Also accepts: Radix primitive props.
Example: `<TooltipProvider><Tooltip><TooltipTrigger asChild><Button>Hover</Button></TooltipTrigger><TooltipContent>Hint</TooltipContent></Tooltip></TooltipProvider>`

### TooltipContent
Props:
- variant?: "dark" | "light" (default "dark")
- icon?: LucideIcon
- title?: string
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes, Radix primitive props.
Example: `<TooltipContent variant="light">Hint</TooltipContent>`

### TooltipProvider
Also accepts: Radix primitive props.
Example: `<TooltipProvider delayDuration={200}>{app}</TooltipProvider>`

### TooltipTrigger
Also accepts: native HTML/React attributes, Radix primitive props.
Example: `<TooltipTrigger asChild><Button>Hover</Button></TooltipTrigger>`

### Uploader
Props:
- maxSizeBytes?: number (default 1024 * 1024) — Defaults to 1 MB, matching the spec.
- accept?: string
- multiple?: boolean (default true)
- disabled?: boolean (default false)
- forceActive?: boolean (default false) — Docs-only: force the drag-active look without a real drag.
- className?: string
Example: `<Uploader />`

## Utilities

- buttonClasses({ color, variant, size }) — Button's class string, for styling links as buttons.
- useToast() — returns toast(options: ToastOptions); call inside <Toaster>.
- cn(...classes) — merge class names (clsx + tailwind-merge).
